note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962 UBS wording and the OT wordings once reused from other Amharic works. The closing appendix (chapter 13) repeats the body's quotations under each citation; each is quoted identically in both places, and the two-block quotations (John 10:11-12, 1 Timothy 4:12-16, 2 Timothy 4:3) are split at the same paragraph break as before.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole cited verse or range, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…' (where the author's English skips words). `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions and bare citations, left as the translator's prose. Where the author's prose argues from a word OWB words differently, the prose follows OWB: Ezekiel 34:16's verbs, 'out of season' (2 Timothy 4:2), Paul's 'overseer' (ጠባቂ), 'mature in Christ' (Colossians 1:28, በክርስቶስ የበሰለ), John 21:16 'Take care of my sheep' (three words, as in the English), 'with perseverance' (Hebrews 12:1) and 'the great Shepherd of the sheep' (Hebrews 13:20).
